guide.title: Guide to Effective Prompts
guide.subtitle: Learn best practices for writing effective prompts
guide.be_specific_desc: Provide clear details about what you want. Vague prompts produce vague results.
guide.context_matters_desc: Provide relevant background so the AI understands your request better.
guide.role_assignment_desc: Tell the AI what role to assume. E.g: 'Act as an expert in...'
guide.format_output_desc: Indicate how you want the response presented (JSON, table, steps, etc).
guide.examples_desc: Examples help the AI better understand what you expect.
guide.iterate_desc: Adjust the prompt based on results. Iteration improves outputs.
guide.good_example: Act as a technology expert. Write a 1500-word article about how artificial intelligence is transforming the job market in 2025. Include: 1) Introduction, 2) Three real use cases, 3) Economic impact, 4) Conclusion. Tone: professional but accessible. Format: Markdown with headers and bullet points.
guide.tip1: Use PromptGG generator to save time and get optimized prompts
guide.tip2: Always provide context: For whom? Why? When?
guide.tip3: Specify the desired format (JSON, table, list, numbered steps)
guide.tip4: Assign a role to the AI: "Act as a...", "You are an expert in..."
guide.tip5: Provide examples of the desired output when possible
guide.tip6: Iterate: If the result isn't perfect, adjust the prompt and try again
